alternatives_and_negative_results: Optional stopping, post-hoc sample supplementation, reuse of accepted S03 seeds, or converting an execution failure into a valid trial are rejected.
applicability: Monte Carlo acceptance and deterministic fixed-denominator qualification.
assessed_root_cause: Acceptance evidence requires immutable source identity and predeclared sample/seed/disposition rules; operational failure is not permission to erase a consumed attempt.
author_role: historical project engineering record, backfilled by FPGA engineering copilot
chosen_corrective_method: Prelock IDs/seeds and fixed denominators; record an attempt before processing; never auto-retry or replace; create a new separately authorized campaign if a replacement is approved.
generalizable_lesson: One-shot acceptance must be auditable at the unit-of-analysis level, including failed invocations and explicit replacement authorization.
initial_faulty_assumption_or_design_deci: An invalid or failed invocation might be retried under the same campaign or silently supplemented to reach a desired denominator.
non_applicability: Does not prohibit separately authorized diagnostic runs that are clearly outside acceptance and do not consume acceptance samples.
observable_consequence: S03 preserves an initial Pd import-failure attempt as INCONCLUSIVE with zero CPI and a separately authorized second run; C06 preserves its first 16-CPI INCONCLUSIVE campaign and uses a separately prelocked 16-CPI replacement campaign.
observed_problem: Acceptance evidence is vulnerable to selection bias if source code, random streams, trial count or stopping rules change after results are observed.
repeatable_validation: Verify the old and replacement attempt ledgers, distinct CPI IDs/Seeds, one attempt per CPI, preserved INCONCLUSIVE status and the replacement report.
reviewer_role: documentary evidence validation by FPGA engineering copilot; not a separate human reviewer
safety_contract_constraints: Never mutate old ledger or seed; no automatic retry, deletion, or denominator adjustment.
title: Freeze code, seed, denominator and stopping rule before one-shot acceptance trials
